# openai_project_spend_alert (Resource)

Manages an email spend alert for an OpenAI project. Threshold amounts are specified in cents.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openai_project_spend_alert" "monthly" {
  project_id       = "proj_abc123"
  threshold_amount = 100000

  notification_channel {
    recipients     = ["finance@example.com"]
    subject_prefix = "OpenAI spend alert"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `notification_channel` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notification_channel))
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project.
- `threshold_amount` (Number) The spend threshold in cents.

### Optional

- `currency` (String) The threshold currency. Currently only `USD` is supported.
- `interval` (String) The evaluation interval. Currently only `month` is supported.

### Read-Only

- `alert_id` (String) The OpenAI spend alert ID.
- `id` (String) The composite `project_id:alert_id` identifier.
- `object` (String) The OpenAI object type.

<a id="nestedatt--notification_channel"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notification_channel`

Required:

- `recipients` (Set of String) Email addresses that receive the alert.

Optional:

- `subject_prefix` (String) Optional subject prefix for alert emails.
- `type` (String) The notification type. Currently only `email` is supported.
